_comment: Vampyre rules at parity with the official calculator's engine (osrs-dps-calc 89c3e25b: PlayerVsNPCCalc vampyre accuracy, damage, tier-2 transforms and immunity; BaseCalc isWearingSilverWeapon and wearingVampyrebane; PR #671) - ISS-01M5RM2A7FFR9XWKATPX877TDD. Names match the lower-cased item NAME exactly. silver = silver weapons in melee (the wiki's Silver weaponry adds the diamond sickles, emberlight and the blisterwood sickle (e), newer than the calc's list; silvthrill is a quest-only ballista in neither). silverRanged = silver ammo, or the stake as the weapon (the calc's 'Silver bolts#version' names never match a worn item; its intent and the wiki count them). bane2 = vampyrebane vs tier 2 in ANY style (the calc's wearingVampyrebane), bane3 = vs tier 3 in melee only; the blisterwood stake is vampyrebane in ranged at both tiers. numbers: 'acc <weapon>' = the melee roll per cent vs any vampyre, after the post rules; 'dmg <weapon>' = the per-hit per cent vs any vampyre, Efaritay's aid scaling the hit by efaritayDamage first; a silver weapon without its own entry takes silverTier1 vs tier 1 (the calc's 'Rod of ivandis' branch is lower-case and dead - the rod gets only that). Tier 2 last: no vampyrebane + Efaritay's aid halves each hit, else silver caps it at tier2Cap. Each step floors.
